name: verifypass-monorepo
description: Multitenant liveness, face recognition, and ID verification service

scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend/sdk/core && npm test --prefix frontend/dashboard && node --test deploy/tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.test:email: php email-api/test/self-test.php && php email-api/test/security-test.php && node --test backend/tests/emailTriggers.test.js
scripts.test:flutter: (cd flutter-sdk && flutter test) && (cd flutter-app && flutter test)
scripts.build: npm run prisma:validate --prefix backend && npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && (cd frontend/sdk/js && npm run build) && (cd frontend/dashboard && npm run build) && (cd frontend/verify-page && npm run build) && (cd sample-app && npm run build)
